Business / EV support

A vehicle for
the shift ahead.

When a rider needs a rental EV, our field team checks availability and records who has the vehicle, when it was handed over and when it comes back.

Ask about EV availability ↗
01 / Vehicle lifecycle

Follow one
rental EV.

A recorded handover gives the rider, the recruiter and the payout team a common starting point.

  1. 01
    Before the shift

    Check the assignment

    The field team checks the rider, hub and vehicle before confirming a rental. Availability and rental terms are discussed locally.

  2. 02
    At handover

    Record the vehicle and date

    The rider is linked to a particular EV. The handover date establishes when that assignment starts.

  3. 03
    While in use

    Report vehicle issues

    Tell the field team which vehicle is affected and what happened. Maintenance can be recorded against that EV.

  4. 04
    At return

    Close the assignment

    Return the vehicle through the team. The return record helps the office review which days belong in the rider’s rent calculation.

Three records.

Select a point on the vehicle to see what the field team tracks through a rental.

EV ASSIGNMENT  /  FIG. A
RECORD 01 / HANDOVER

Who has the keys?

The handover links one rider to one vehicle and records when the rental begins.

Rider · Vehicle · Handover date
RECORD 02 / MAINTENANCE

What needs attention?

An issue or repair follows the vehicle’s record. The field team can look up the EV involved when the rider reports a problem.

RECORD 03 / RETURN

When did use end?

The return closes the assignment. The office uses this record when checking the period covered by a rental deduction.

02 / Rental and earnings

Where fleet meets
the paysheet.

A rental is attached to a rider and a period. Keeping the dates right matters when the office checks earnings.

FOR HUB MANAGERS

Plan the vehicle mix

Include the number of riders who may need an EV, the reporting point and the intended start date in your staffing brief.

FOR RIDERS

Check a rental deduction

If a deduction looks wrong, give the team the pay period and the handover or return date. Do not email bank or identity documents.

03 / Fleet questions

Before the
handover.

Raise questions about the vehicle and its terms before accepting it.

Is a rental EV guaranteed?＋

No. The field team must confirm local stock, eligibility and terms for the specific assignment.

Can a rider use their own vehicle?＋

Tell the recruiter what vehicle the rider already has. The team can discuss whether it fits the opportunities available in that area.

What if an EV changes hands?＋

Contact the field team so the outgoing return and the new handover can be recorded against the correct riders.
